I5.quote: We report on a macroscopic study on the behavior of spillover H atoms using carbon black-supported Pt nanoparticles (CB/Pt) and various organic compounds adsorbed by microporous activated carbon (AC).

notes: Article on hydrogen spillover reactivity. H2 uptake is measured on a BELSORP HP pressure-difference (volumetric) instrument at 25 C and shown only in figures (Fig. 1e MoO3 mixtures; Fig. 3, 4a, 5a CB/Pt and AC mixtures). Carbon sorbent: pristine AC (MSP20N, SBET 1980 m2/g) curve in Fig. 4a reaches about 0.26 wt% near 3.1 MPa, reversible; the text does not say whether that pristine-AC curve was run with CB/Pt mixed in (caption: 'AC and the mixtures of CB/Pt and aromatic hydrocarbon-adsorbed ACs'). MoO3 uptake is non-carbon and reactive; organic-loaded AC curves partly reflect hydrogenation. Primary research article (not a review). record.json is_retracted is false and the PDF text has no retraction statement. No statement that the H2 uptake values were published before (searched main and SI text), so duplicate_data does not apply.
